_comment: The operator's DECLARED notes on single players: who is out of the squad, who has fallen out with
his club, who has asked to leave. Same standing as `board_rulings.json` and the same reason - it is
a judgement the model cannot reach, so it is declared rather than inferred (root CLAUDE.md, «A
judgement the model cannot reach is DECLARED, not adopted as a parameter»).
WHY IT IS DECLARED AND NOT MEASURED. Nothing in this project observes a quarrel. The database holds
`flags.exit_risk` (a contract expiring within twelve months - a fact about a CONTRACT, never about a
relationship), the transfers layer (a move that HAS happened) and the live squad read (a man absent
from a payload, which is evidence of a departure and not of a dispute). Reading any of the three as
«he has fallen out with the club» would be inventing a fact from a different one. So it is written
down by whoever knows it, dated, and revocable by deleting the entry.
WHAT IT MAY NEVER DO. Nothing under `engine/` reads this file and nothing should: a declared fact
that moved a FITTED number would make every measurement the operator's own answer, which is exactly
what the two board judges refuse (`apply_rulings=False`). It enters no valuation, no gate, no board.
WHAT IT MAY DO, since 15/08/2026 and by the operator's own decision («penalizzarli gravemente
nell'overall»): the APP's Overall column reads it. That column is reporting too - no gate owns it, no
judge scores it, nothing is fitted on it - so a declared fact and a measured one can meet there
without contaminating anything that is judged. The discount is declared in `player-ratings.ts`
(DECLARED_RISK) and the row's tooltip says which word caused it.
SHAPE: {season: {fc_id: {kind, note, decided_on}}}.
* `fc_id`   the fantacalcio.it id, this project's primary key - never a name, because a name join
is the defect this repository has already paid for four times. The auction panel and
the players table both show the id in the row's tooltip.
* `kind`    one of `out_of_squad` (fuori rosa), `dispute` (rottura con la societa'), `wants_out`
(ha chiesto di andare via). One icon serves all three - the operator's own grouping,
11/08/2026 - and the word decides what the tooltip says.
* `note`    free text, shown as written: what happened and where it was read.
* `decided_on` the day it was declared. A note is about a market that moves, so a reader can see
how old it is instead of trusting it forever.
HOW IT TRAVELS: `export` copies it into the bundle's `config/`, `npm run data:pull` into the app's
`public/data/`, and the app reads the season the bundle targets. Adding a name therefore costs an
export, a pull and a deploy - the operator's own choice of 11/08/2026, over an app-local list, so
the declaration lives in git and is the same on every device.
